name: Abihail (daughter of Eliab)
title: Wife of Rehoboam from the line of David
summary: Abihail was the daughter of Eliab, David's brother, and became one of King Rehoboam's wives. Through her, David's lineage continued into the royal house of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Wife of Rehoboam
keyEvents.description: Rehoboam took Abihail, daughter of David's brother Eliab, as his wife.
